** Original Review**
I've used overcast for years and loved it, the smart speed and voice boost features are fantastic.

However, the recent update which the developer seems strangely proud of has ruined the experience. Basic functionality remains broken weeks after the new version was released and the developer has now taken to publicly ridiculing his customers on his podcast show.

Previously played episodes reappear in playlists, playlists reorder themselves randomly, downloads frequently fail, and airplay playback is a stuttering mess.

I'm considering leaving the app for one of the many alternatives available, unfortunately the ability to export subscriptions was removed in the recent update - so it's a frustrating, manual process to leave.
I'd suggest the developer listens to his own podcasts, the criticism he has rightly levelled at the likes of Jonny Ive and Apple over the years is something he needs to hear.

I hope that in time I will come back and revise this review, but as of right now - avoid at all costs.

I have used overcast since it first existed. By far it was the best podcast app around. 
But the new 10 year update has encouraged me to write my first ever app review to share my feedback. 

Streaming is gone all together. Which is the biggest crux for me. Waiting for episodes to download first is making the app and the listening experience slower all round. 

The ability to sort ‘current’ and ‘all’ episodes of a show separately is gone, making it harder to sort through content. 

Much of the time when listening to a show or a playlist now, the next episode doesn’t auto play. 

I could go on, but basically the whole thing is feeling slower and clunkier than before. 

It may look prettier in places, but the functionality seems to have been impacted massively.  

I hope some of the things are restored. Particularly streaming or I will have to start searching elsewhere for the first time in a decade.
